veterinaryNurse.description: Provided intensive care in the ICU of a 24-hour emergency animal hospital for four years. Developed a strong understanding of clinical workflows, teamwork, and decision-making under pressure.

softwareDeveloper.description: 5+ years of experience developing healthcare web applications with TypeScript, Vue.js, C#, and SQL. Lead frontend development of a biometric data analysis app used across 10+ healthcare facilities, translating Figma designs into production-ready interfaces. Also develop backend APIs, database functionality, and clinical alarm analysis features, contributing to testing, code reviews, and UX improvements.

volunteerDeveloper.description: Contribute to web development for Social Bridge Canada using Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS, supporting the development of accessible and responsive user interfaces.
